messages:
alex: Starting a short thread for Q1 hosted capacity planning — please keep replies focused. Need decision buy vs lease + region split by end of next week.

alex: Quick snapshot from live telemetry: week-over-week trending implies ~22-30% QoQ growth in token throughput. Forecast scenarios attached (will push spreadsheet).

alex: Basic model (order-of-magnitude):
```
- Projected global peak tokens/s: 3500 (mid-ramp aggressive)
- Effective tokens/s per A100-80GB-equivalent under our mix: ~280
- Ideal GPUs = ceil(3500 / 280) = 13
- Concurrency/caching/real-world multiplier: 7x => ~91 GPUs
- Add surge headroom 35% => ~123 GPUs total for peak window
- Steady monthly average target: ~65 GPUs (expected util 55-70%)
- Ops reserve for rolling upgrades/failover: +12 GPUs (10%) => target fleet ~135 GPUs
```

maria: Timeline question: when do ops need capacity online? Also EU colo constraints this quarter, likely +6w lead on hardware.

alex: Ops target: online by week 3 of Jan for baseline (65 GPUs) and have surge capacity rampable by week 6. Buys typically 10-14 weeks lead (customs + rack prep), leases ~3-5 weeks depending on region.

jason: Cost roughs (region + term variance):
- Lease baseline estimate: $2.0-$3.0 / GPU-hour depending on term/region
- Buy CAPEX card cost: $10.5k-$13.5k + rack/power/network (~$1.4k per unit effective)
- Example: 135 GPUs buy ~ $1.45M hardware + infra ~ $190k one-time; lease monthly baseline 135*24*30*$2.4 ~ $234k/mo

finance: Suggest hybrid: commit-to-12mo lease for baseline 65 GPUs (predictable OPEX) + short-term leases (3mo) for the remaining surge. We'll evaluate capex if discounts > 15%.

paul: EU note: three EU racks reporting limited supply; if we need buys in EU we must submit purchase order within 8 business days. Otherwise plan traffic shaping to shift non-EU traffic during peak.

devx: Optimization levers to reduce GPU-hours: improved prefix caching (we estimate 9% token reduction), trimming KV persistence for low-value endpoints (~4%), and a short quantization rollout for heavy tails (~6%). Combined could reduce peak need by ~15% if rolled fast.

sre_lead: Cluster mapping: we should avoid colocating all purchased units in one colo. Recommend split baseline across US-EAST, EU-WEST, APAC with automatic failover. Also reserve a pool of preemptible instances in US for short spikes. Will draft mapping.

alex: One more modeling note: per-model throughput varies widely. I ran a quick per-model Pareto: 70% of tokens come from 2 models, so prioritize those for higher-perf GPUs and KV caching.

infra-bot: procurement-created: PR-2026-311 by maria at 1793005800.

jason: Negotiation trick: add mid-term swap clause in lease allowing exchange to next-gen equivalent within 6-9 months. Vendors are open at scale.

maria: Action items (owners):
- alex: run 10k-sample Monte Carlo across traffic seasonality and return 3 scenarios (conservative/expected/aggressive) by Fri EOD (include per-region split).
- procurement: gather 3 lease quotes per region + 2 buy bids, include swap clause options, due Tue next week.
- sre_lead/jason: share cluster topology draft and failover plan by Thu.
- devx: quick runbook for caching/quantization deploy that can be toggled if we need to trim peak within 48h.

finance: We'll model TCO and runway impact; if buy provides >18% NPV savings over 24mo we'll greenlight procurement recommendation. Expect internal review in 5 business days.

paul: Note: APAC historically spikes in late Jan - early Feb for region-specific traffic (holiday/promotions). Factor an APAC-focused aggressive scenario.

alex: OK. Hybrid + implement caching tweaks looks best path for now. Ill upload the Monte Carlo sheet and per-model throughput breakdown when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jason: +1 on hybrid + swap clause. Ping me if you need vendor contacts.

maria: Will create procurement ticket and attach vendor shortlist.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: procurement ticket PR-2026-311 updated at 1793006040.

alex: End of thread  follow-ups in the procurement doc.
